# Mod API: Surfaces, Elements, and Render Sites

An element is a building block of a drawing, such as `Box`, `Text`, or `Button`.
A render site is a part of Claude Code that a mod may redraw, such as the spinner or the prompt hint.
A `ui.render` hook gets the site in `e.component` and returns a tree of elements.
This hook adds a tail to the hint line under the prompt:

```javascript
on('ui.render', { component: 'PromptHint' }, async ($, e, next) =>
  next({ ...e, props: { ...e.props, tail: ' (mod)' } }))
```

There are no string tags in JSX.
Every tag is an element from `$.ui.resolve(e)`, and JSX compiles a tag to `h(Box, props, ...children)`.
The 15 render sites are `AskUserQuestion`, `UserMessage`, `AssistantMessage`, `ToolUse`, `ToolResult`, `ToolGroup`, `ToolProgress`, `CommandOutput`, `Spinner`, `TurnDuration`, `InfoNotice`, `SessionMode`, `PromptHint`, `AbovePrompt`, and `Pane`.
The engine alone draws the permission dialog.
A mod adds context to it with `$.ui.notice`.

## JSX and Globals

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `h(tag, props, ...children)` | The JSX factory. Classic runtime. Returns a plain-data element from a string tag or a component. | JSX compiles to bare `h(...)` calls. A module must not declare, import, or take as a parameter anything named `h` or `Fragment` where it writes JSX. The engine adds the pragma. | Hooks modules and surface modules. | `global` block of `claude-code` (line 15462 to 15586), [Mods Overview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/overview) |
| ✅ | `Fragment` | `<>...</>`. A column `Box` around the children. | Same naming rule as `h`. | Hooks modules and surface modules. | `global` block of `claude-code` (line 15462 to 15586) |
| ✅ | `JSX` namespace | `Element` is `RenderElement`. `IntrinsicElements` is empty, so there are no string tags. `IntrinsicAttributes` allows `key`. | Every tag is a constructor from `$.ui.resolve(e)`, as in `const { Box, Text } = $.ui.resolve(e)`. | Files named `.tsx` or `.jsx`. | `global` block of `claude-code` (line 15462 to 15586) |
| ✅ | Web globals | `URL`, `URLSearchParams`, `TextEncoder`, `TextDecoder`, `AbortController`, `AbortSignal`, `atob`, `btoa`, `structuredClone`, `crypto.subtle.digest`, `crypto.randomUUID`, `crypto.getRandomValues`, and `performance.now`. | No DOM, no Node, no `require`, no `import()`. `eval` and `new Function` over a string throw. There is no `WebAssembly`. A surface module also has `console` and no timers. | Hooks modules and surface modules. | `global` block of `claude-code` (line 15462 to 15586) |
| ✅ | Module rules | A file is named `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.jsx`, `.js`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`, `.mts`, or `.cts`. It is an ES module whatever its suffix. | A file of the plugin is imported with an `import` declaration. A module with `import()` does not load. `on`, `$`, `$.env` names, and `$.state` references must be spelled literally. | Hooks modules. | Header comment of the d.ts, `PluginRegisterUses` line 7886 |
